system.summary: Wit; 3 Sharp; Medium (50 ft). Deployable and Trap, as for the Bear Trap: set on a hex, an enemy moving toward it must pass a CR 2 Wit Check to go around, or it stumbles in and takes the damage.

automation.note: Deployable and Trap: place the caltrops on a hex. An enemy moving toward it makes a CR 2 Wit Check. On a success it goes around; on a failure it takes 3 Sharp and the Sharp save. There is no Strike roll, so apply the damage by hand.
